title: Omega overthrows Styles & rises as a heavyweight
summary: Kenny Omega stops accepting a supporting role in Bullet Club. An attack on AJ Styles announces his move into the heavyweight division, followed immediately by an Intercontinental title pursuit.

chapters.title: Omega expels Styles
chapters.result: Omega and his allies attack AJ Styles after their tag match.
chapters.context: The former junior champion declares himself a heavyweight and claims leadership of a new Elite-centered faction chapter.

chapters.title: The takeover produces a championship
chapters.result: Omega defeats Tanahashi for the vacant Intercontinental title.
chapters.context: With Nakamura gone, Tanahashi becomes the obstacle between Omega’s declaration and a major heavyweight championship.
